test_arithmetic_ops_series_scalar: test arithmetic operations between a Series and a scalar using all arithmetic operators
test_arithmetic_ops_frame_scalar: test arithmetic operations between a DataFrame and a scalar using all arithmetic operators
test_arithmetic_ops_series_array: test arithmetic operations between a Series and another Series array using all arithmetic operators
test_divmod_operations: test divmod behavior matches floor division and modulo for Series with scalar and array inputs
test_add_extension_array_to_series: test adding an ExtensionArray to a Series of the same dtype matches direct array addition
test_direct_arith_ndframe_not_implemente: test that EAs return NotImplemented for ops with Series, DataFrame, or Index inputs
test_compare_scalar: test comparison operations between a Series and a scalar match point-wise comparisons
test_compare_array: test comparison operations between two Series match point-wise comparisons
test_invert_operator: test the invert operator (~) on a Series and its underlying ExtensionArray
test_unary_ufunc_dunder_equivalence: test that unary ufuncs (positive, negative, abs) match their corresponding dunder methods
